content:
I finished my project to formalize Martin's theorem on Borel determinacy in descriptive set theory. This may be added to mathlib if people are interested. Thank you @Floris van Doorn for supporting me!
Discussions: https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113488-general/topic/Discussions.20.22Borel.20determinacy.22
Repository: https://github.com/sven-manthe/A-formalization-of-Borel-determinacy-in-Lean
(Edit) Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03432
